Investor Madhusudan Kela Buys Gurugram Apartment for ₹121 Crore

Veteran stock market investor Madhusudan Murlidhar Kela has purchased a luxury apartment worth ₹120.71 crore at DLF's ultra-premium residential project, *The Dahlias*, in Gurugram.

The apartment has a carpet area of 6,233 sq ft and comes with five basement parking spaces. The deal works out to nearly ₹2 lakh per sq ft, placing Gurugram's luxury real estate market alongside some of the country's and world's most expensive property destinations.

The Dahlias has emerged as a preferred address for ultra-high-net-worth individuals. The project has also seen major purchases by an NCR-based industrialist, who reportedly acquired four apartments worth nearly ₹380 crore, and former cricketer Shikhar Dhawan.

Spread across 7.5 million sq ft, the development comprises 420 residences across eight towers and features a 3.5 lakh sq ft clubhouse. The project has recorded sales of ₹18,569 crore in just 18 months, with around 60% of inventory already sold.

DLF has projected sales guidance of ₹20,000 crore for FY27 and ended FY26 with zero gross debt in its development business and a net cash surplus of ₹14,155 crore.
